packageRules.description: rolldown-plugin-dts is pinned in pnpm-workspace.yaml's overrides (see the comment there) because 0.27.10+ ships a .d.mts that unconditionally references the optional @volar/typescript peer dependency, which breaks tsc (TS2307) here since we have no skipLibCheck. Still present as of 0.28.0. Re-enable once upstream fixes the type leak (https://github.com/sxzz/rolldown-plugin-dts).
